title: fix(slot): a picked Slot stays inside its edges or face
body:
## What changed

A plain Slot picked on the part now stays inside its picks (#1504, P1 gouge).

- **Shared law, `crates/motion/src/machining2d/slot_room.rs`** (new): `SlotBound` is the room a selection allows. `SlotBound::from_edges(e1, e2)` is the strip between two straight, parallel, facing edges over their shared length. `SlotBound::from_face(region)` is a picked face's (or closed ring's) region, framed by its minimum-area rectangle (rotating calipers). `fit()` gives the slot that fills the room. `confine(a, b, width)` refuses by name, with numbers, a slot that is too wide, too long or placed past the picks. It is world-free, so the Trochoidal slot (#1503, M5) can call the same `confine`. Coordination comment posted on #1503.
- **App, `crates/app/src/operation/slot_pick.rs`** (new): `slot_bound_of(world, items)` resolves the picks (two open edges, or one face or closed ring; anything else is refused by name). `slot_from_picks` seeds the fitted a/b/width. `slot_fit_of` is the page echo.
- **Seeding, undoable:** `SetOperationGeometry` (and `CreateOperation` on picks) writes the fitted endpoints and width in the same command, the Probe's pick-seeding pattern, so one undo takes back the pick and the seed. MCP `set_operation_geometry` and `add_operation` call the same commands, so MCP has parity with no new tool.
- **Confine at generation and preview:** the job collects the picked Slot's room. The Slot arm calls `confine` before generating, and the preview's `region_for` draws nothing for a slot that does not fit. A slot is never previewed across a wall.
- **Gouge law:** a Slot with a Selection source now takes `DepthLaw::Section`, the picked pocket family's law. A picked slot cut below the floor is convicted as a `Gouge`, which blocks the post. A Stock or whole-model source is unchanged: no part law, typed endpoints rule.
- **Page:** the Geometry tab echoes `From selection: room L x W mm - the slot stays inside it`, or the refusal generation would make. The Boundary text for Slot (`area_unsupported`) now says the endpoints and width are seeded from the picks and kept inside them. TrochoidalSlot's text is untouched, split into its own arm for #1503.

Decision file: `docs/decisions/1504-slot-selection.md`. It covers the seed plus confine law, why it is not Circular's "picks author it outright" law, and the tolerances.

## Relation to #1513 (M5, Trochoidal slot)

Not stacked. #1513 adds `crates/app/src/operation/slot_fit.rs::refuse_unfit_slot(kind, a, b, width, region)`, a region-capsule law wired into the TrochoidalSlot arm. This PR keeps its own `SlotBound` for three reasons:
- The reported case is two open edges. `selection_drives_region` / `selection_region` refuse open runs for every kind but the contour, so flipping Slot there would refuse the edges before a region exists.
- A region law cannot read the strip two edges bound.
- The motion module was renamed `slot_room` so it does not share a name with #1513's `operation::slot_fit`.

The two PRs touch no common file hunk. `git merge-tree` of this head with #1513's head and with upstream/main is clean both ways. Unifying the two laws (TrochoidalSlot on `SlotBound`, or `refuse_unfit_slot` as a wrapper) is a P7 follow-up.

## How tested (pinning tests, each mutation-checked)

`crates/app/tests/slot_picks.rs`. The fixture is a 50 x 50 x 20 block with a 30 x 16 pocket to z 10, and a 10 mm end mill.
- `two_pocket_edges_give_a_slot_inside_the_pocket_and_undo_takes_it_back`: the seed is (-7,0)-(7,0), width 16. It generates with no blocking warning, every feed stays inside the pocket, and undo restores the typed slot and source.
- `the_floor_face_gives_the_slot_that_fits_it`
- `a_slot_longer_than_the_picked_edges_is_refused_by_name_and_not_previewed`: "56.000 mm long end to end ... share only 30.000 mm", and `region_of` is None.
- `a_slot_wider_than_the_picked_edges_is_refused_by_name`: "20.000 mm wide ... only 16.000 mm apart".
- `a_slot_through_the_pocket_wall_is_refused_and_one_below_the_floor_holds_the_post`: "runs 4.000 mm outside". The fitted slot with Bottom 5 gives a blocking `Gouge`.
- `with_nothing_picked_the_typed_endpoints_rule_as_before`: Entity and Stock sources cut the typed slot through the wall, with no gouge, as before.
- `mcp_picks_seed_and_confine_the_slot_through_the_same_command`: MCP picks the two long floor chains, generates ok and verifies ok. A width of 20 is then refused by name.

`crates/motion/src/machining2d/slot_room_tests.rs` has 7 unit pins: edges fit, too wide, too long, misplaced, skew, collinear, no overlap, bowed, short, face fit, square, L-shaped face, and island.

`crates/ui/src/egui_app/slot_pick_page_tests.rs::picked_edges_seed_the_slot_echo_its_room_and_undo_together` is a structural (AccessKit) check: the echo is shown, the refusal is shown for a too-wide draft, and undo clears both. No PNGs.

Mutation results. Each mutation was applied alone and reverted after.

| Mutation | Pins that fail |
|---|---|
| M1: no `confine` in the Slot arm | 4 (too long, too wide, through the wall, MCP) |
| M2: no `DepthLaw::Section` for picked Slot | 1 (below the floor) |
| M3: no seed in `SetOperationGeometry` | 3 (edges, face, MCP) |
| M4: part law on every Slot, picked or not | 1 (no selection keeps old behaviour) |
| M5: no preview confine | 2 (not previewed) |
| M6: `FIT_TOL` loosened to 5 mm | 3 |
| UI: echo not drawn | the UI pin |

**Review fix (pullrequestreview-5897917927).** Each mutation was applied alone and reverted after. Pins run: motion `--lib slot_room` and app `slot_picks` + `slot_pick_refusals`.

| Mutation | Pins that fail |
|---|---|
| M7: `FIT_TOL` 0.01 -> 0.1 | 4 (edge near-miss, face near-miss, stadium unit, stadium app) |
| M8: `FIT_TOL` 0.01 -> 0.5 | 4 (same) |
| M9: `STRAIGHT_TOL` 0.01 -> 0.1 | 1 (edge bowing 0.02) |
| M10: `STRAIGHT_TOL` 0.01 -> 1.0 | 2 (edge bowing, degenerate picks) |
| M11: face law, drop the wall law (region edges vs the slot's centre segment) | 6 |
| M12: face law, drop the end law (end centre outside the region) | 1 (slot wholly past the face / in a hole) |
| M13: `slot_bound_of` `([e1, e2], 0)` -> `([e1, e2, ..], 0)` | 1 (selection shapes) |
| M14: `slot_bound_of` `([], 1)` -> `(_, 1)` | 1 (selection shapes) |
| M15: `slot_bound_of` Vertex/Patch arm -> `continue` | 1 (selection shapes) |
| M16: `slot_bound_of` gone model -> `continue` | 1 (selection shapes) |
| M17: `from_face` drop "bounds no area" | 1 (degenerate picks) |
| M18: `fit` drop "no width" | 1 (degenerate picks) |
| M19: `from_edges` drop "first edge has no length" | 1 (degenerate picks) |
| M20: `confine` drop the finite / width > 0 guard | 1 (degenerate picks) |
| M21: `fit` drop the inscribe | 2 (stadium unit, stadium app) |
| M22: `judge` drop the picks' reason (plain confine) | 1 (coarse face says why) |
| M23: `CreateOperation` drop the seed | 1 (created on picks) |
| M24: `CreateOperation` undo keeps the op | 1 (created on picks) |

Quick gate: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` green on 7eb71146: motion suites ok (163 s), app suites ok (741 s, `slot_picks` included), ui suites ok (38 s); wall 15.8 min, 0 failed. f35bd14e only rewrites four `!(x > t)` guards as NaN-explicit comparisons for clippy; the three pinning sets were re-run on it, green. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings` is clean.

New pins (review fix): `crates/motion/src/machining2d/slot_room_pins.rs` (8: edge-room and face-room near misses, edge bowing, face wall law, face end law, stadium inscribed, coarse face says why, degenerate picks and numbers) and `crates/app/tests/slot_pick_refusals.rs` (3: `picks_that_bound_no_slot_are_refused_by_name`, `a_slot_created_on_picks_takes_the_slot_between_them_and_undo_removes_it`, `a_tessellated_stadium_floor_face_seeds_the_inscribed_slot` - the reviewer's `rounded_rect(15, 8, 8, 8)` fixture).

Review-fix behaviour changes:
- `fit()` inscribes a face's slot: the radius is drawn in by the measured face overshoot (chord sag), capped at 5% of the room width (`INSCRIBE_MAX`); beyond that the face is refused. `FIT_TOL` is unchanged.
- `SlotBound::judge` (used by generation, the preview and the page echo) appends "the picks seed no slot: <reason>" when the picks bound no slot, so the user is not left with a bare length refusal.
- `face_overshoot` is exact (moved to `slot_room_face.rs`): region boundary segments against the slot's centre segment, plus end-centre containment, in place of 0.5 mm sampling.

## Not exercised

- A real STEP pocket with tessellated round ends was not run. A synthetic 8-chords-per-quarter stadium (0.039 mm sag) is now pinned and inscribed; coarser STEP tessellation inscribes up to 5% of the width.
- A face with point-ended (one chord per quarter) round ends: its minimum-area rectangle can turn diagonal (a hexagon's), so the frame is not the slot's axis; it is refused by name either way, never seeded wrong.
- Follow-up filed: #1537 (P1) - a Slot with a whole-model (entity) source takes no part law, so a typed slot through the finished part raises no gouge. Pre-existing; not changed here.
- Re-picking re-seeds over a user-shortened slot: kept by design (one undo restores it), recorded in the decision file.
- A Slot under a 3+2 tilt with picks is still refused upstream ("a tilted plane cannot yet index a picked selection"), unchanged.
- Refusal numbers print in mm regardless of the document's display unit, like the slot generator's other refusals.
- The TrochoidalSlot is not wired. That is #1503 (M5), which can call `SlotBound::confine`.

Changelog: A Slot with two opposite edges or a face picked now takes the slot between them (centre line, length, width - undoable with the pick), refuses by name a slot too wide, too long or placed past its picks (never previewed across a wall), and is judged against the part so a slot cut below the picked floor holds the post (#1504)

Review-fix quick gate: `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` green on b1e25d27 (merged with upstream/main): motion 147 s, app 765 s (incl. `slot_picks`, `slot_pick_refusals`), ui 57 s; wall 16.2 min, 0 failed. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings` clean.

Effort: high (no escalation)

Fork synced at v0.19.0; branched from upstream/main df90b031.

Fixes #1504
